amounts.description: Named amounts in integer cents. Required for transitions with a posting_rule.

context_patch.description: JSON object merged into the instance context (shallow merge via `||`).

entry_date.description: Accounting date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today when absent.

total_cents.description: Total open invoice amount in this bucket, in integer cents.

AvailableTransitionResponse.description: One legal next move from the current state of a process instance.

oneOf.description: `Some` when this transition requires posting amounts; `null` otherwise.

to_state.description: The state the instance will move to when this transition fires.

BalanceResponse.description: Account balance. All amounts are integer cents (i64).

balance.description:
Type-normalised signed balance in cents (debit-positive for asset/expense,
credit-positive for liability/equity/income).

credits.description: Total credits posted to this account, in cents.

debits.description: Total debits posted to this account, in cents.

ChatAction.description: A single tool invocation with its result.

conversation_id.description:
Stable identifier for this conversation, supplied by the client and kept
for the conversation's lifetime.

It exists so tool idempotency keys can be derived rather than minted at
random (#86). When absent a fresh one is generated per request, which
still deduplicates a model's retries *within* this request — the live
double-post path — but cannot deduplicate across requests. There is no
server-side conversation store yet, so this is the only identity available.

finish_reason.description:
Why the tool loop stopped. Anything other than `completed` means the run
did NOT finish, and `reply` says so rather than claiming success (#88).

ChatTurn.description: A single conversation turn (user or assistant).

actor.description: Audit actor — the subject of the calling token.

effective_date.description: Economic date determining the fiscal period. Defaults to entry_date when absent.

ErrorBody.description:
OpenAPI schema for the error envelope body.

`ol_sdk::ErrorEnvelope` is not `ToSchema`-derived (it lives in the SDK crate
without a utoipa dependency), so we register this local wrapper in the OpenAPI
component map.  The actual wire encoding is [`ErrorEnvelope`] — identical shape.

FinishReason.description:
Why a chat run ended.

Before this existed, a run truncated by the iteration cap was reported with
the canned text "I completed the requested operations." and a `200` — telling
a user that an abandoned multi-step posting had succeeded. For an ERP that is
the wrong failure direction: a user who believes an invoice was posted and
moves on is worse off than one who sees an error (#88).

available.description:
Legal next capabilities from the current state.  Empty when the instance
is terminal (no outgoing transitions).

InstanceResponse.description: A snapshot of a process instance.

InventoryItem.description: One inventory row with a computed on-hand quantity.

on_hand.description:
Net on-hand quantity as a string.  Computed from stock_moves:
receipts (to_location IS NOT NULL) minus issues (from_location IS NOT NULL).

LineRequest.description:
A single journal line in a POST request.  Exactly one of `debit`/`credit`
must be non-zero; both are integer cents (i64).

credit.description: Credit amount in cents. Mutually exclusive with `debit`.

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code. Defaults to "EUR" when absent.

debit.description: Debit amount in cents. Mutually exclusive with `credit`.

ListProcessesResponse.description: List of process names available on the server.

OverviewResponse.description: Snapshot of key financial metrics, all in integer cents.

account_count.description: Total number of accounts in the chart of accounts.

cash_cents.description: Balance of the cash account, code `1000` (debit-positive).

expenses_cents.description: Total balance of all expense accounts (debit-positive).

revenue_cents.description: Total balance of all income accounts (credit-positive).

entry_id.description: Database id of the created (or replayed) journal entry.

replayed.description:
`true` when the idempotency key was already used; the original entry is
returned unchanged.

PostingRequirementResponse.description:
Posting amounts required by an available transition.

`required_amount_keys` lists exactly the keys the caller must supply in the
`amounts` map. The `credit_roles` field describes every account role this
transition credits and is always populated.

credit_roles.description: Every account role this transition credits, always populated.

debit_role.description: The debit role name (for reference; the caller always uses the key `"amount"`).

required_amount_keys.description: Exactly the keys the caller must supply in `amounts`.

PostingRuleResponse.description: GL posting rule: debit one account, credit one or more accounts.

credit.description: Account code(s) to credit.  Multiple accounts are joined with ", ".

ProcessResponse.description: Full detail of a single process, including the rendered Mermaid diagram.

mermaid.description: Mermaid `stateDiagram-v2` source for the full workflow.

steps.description: Optional rich UI metadata for each process step.

transitions.description: State transitions with optional capability labels.

actor.description: Audit actor — recorded in `events`, exactly as a ledger post is.

idempotency_key.description:
Caller-supplied key making the receipt retry-safe. Re-submitting the same
key returns the original `move_id` with `replayed: true` (#90).

qty.description: Quantity as a decimal string, parsed by PostgreSQL as NUMERIC.

unit_cost.description: Optional unit cost as a decimal string, parsed by PostgreSQL as NUMERIC.

replayed.description:
`true` when the idempotency key was already used; the original move is
returned unchanged and no second stock move was created.

context.description: Initial context as a JSON object. Defaults to `{}`.

idempotency_key.description:
UUID idempotency key — reuse the same key to replay without creating a
duplicate instance. If omitted, a deterministic key is derived from the
payload so identical calls are still idempotent.

reference.description: Optional external reference (order number, customer id, etc.).

StepDetailResponse.description: Rich UI metadata for a process state.

StepFieldResponse.description: Field captured while a process step is active.

StepLogResponse.description: One row of the step audit log.

SubledgerReconciliationResponse.description: Sub-ledger reconciliation report: AR and AP control vs sub-ledger check.

ap.description: Accounts Payable reconciliation (GL account '2000' vs open bills).

ar.description: Accounts Receivable reconciliation (GL account '1100' vs open invoices).

SubledgerSection.description: Reconciliation figures for one sub-ledger (AR or AP).

control_balance_cents.description: Balance of the GL control account, in integer cents (type-normalised).

difference_cents.description:
Difference: control_balance_cents - subledger_total_cents. Zero means
reconciliation passes. NULL when subledger_implemented is false.

subledger_implemented.description:
Whether a production write path exists for this sub-ledger. While false,
the sub-ledger is structurally empty and difference_cents is null: the
comparison is not meaningful, and reporting a difference would fabricate
a reconciliation failure equal to the whole control balance (#85).

subledger_total_cents.description: Sum of open document totals in the sub-ledger, in integer cents.

guards.description: Guard expressions that must pass before this transition fires.

oneOf.description: GL posting rule triggered when this transition fires.

TrialBalanceLine.description:
One line in the trial balance — one account/currency pair with raw
debits/credits and a type-normalised signed balance.

account_type.description: Account type as a string (asset, liability, equity, income, expense).

balance_cents.description:
Type-normalised signed balance in integer cents.
asset/expense → debits − credits (debit-positive).
liability/equity/income → credits − debits (credit-positive).

credits_cents.description: Total raw credits posted to this account in this currency, in integer cents.

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code for this line (e.g. "USD", "EUR").

debits_cents.description: Total raw debits posted to this account in this currency, in integer cents.

balanced.description: True when total_debits_cents == total_credits_cents (ledger is in balance).

total_credits_cents.description: Grand total of raw credits across all accounts, in integer cents.

total_debits_cents.description: Grand total of raw debits across all accounts, in integer cents.

ViewDirective.description: View directive returned to the client so the UI can switch modules/focus.

get.description:
- **AR**: compares the balance of GL account `1100` (Accounts Receivable,
  asset — debit-positive) against the sum of all open **posted** invoices
  (`state = 'posted'`). Draft invoices are excluded because they have not
  yet been posted to the AR control account.
- **AP**: compares the balance of GL account `2000` (Accounts Payable,
  liability — credit-positive) against the sum of all open **posted** bills
  (`state = 'posted'`). Draft bills are excluded for the same reason.

`difference_cents` is null while `subledger_implemented` is false, because
the invoices / bills tables currently have no production write path. The
sub-ledger is therefore structurally empty and reporting a numeric
difference would fabricate a reconciliation failure equal to the entire
control balance (issue #85).
get.summary: Get the AR and AP sub-ledger reconciliation report.

get.description:
Each line is keyed by (account, currency). When `?currency=` is supplied only
lines for that currency are returned. When absent, lines for every currency
are returned — one line per (account, currency) pair — so amounts in different
currencies are never mixed on a single line. The grand `total_debits_cents` /
`total_credits_cents` / `balanced` are computed across all returned lines.
Lines are ordered by account code then currency.
